summary:
Results inbox: all 13 items worked and closed under RBC-INBOX-01 and the policies it references.

- pt-0016 Ondricka: The positive FIT (task-00009) was marked entered in error, so I took no action and closed it with a comment. The potassium (task-00011) was corrected from 6.3 to 4.4, which is normal, so I closed it. TSH (task-00010) was normal; closed.
- pt-0006 Patel: The CT urogram (task-00001) showed a 4 mm LLL nodule that his lung cancer screening already follows. I ordered the next screening low-dose chest CT, due between 3/14/27 and 5/14/27, with a tracking task. I messaged the patient and wrote a note. His potassium of 6.3 (task-00002) came from a hemolyzed sample. I ordered an urgent repeat BMP by Monday 10/26 and messaged him to come in. Per RBC-LAB-03 §2, on-call was not notified. Note written.
- pt-0007 Parisian: The inbox CTA chest was the preliminary read (task-00003). The final report found no PE and no nodule (the "nodule" was a blood vessel) and recommends no follow-up, so I closed it with that comment. His BMP (task-00004) meets the AKI rule: creatinine went from 0.98 to 1.64 in about 35 hours. I ordered an urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, messaged him and wrote a note.
- pt-0053 Ruiz (age 16): The inbox knee X-ray was the preliminary read, which was normal (task-00026). The final report shows an aggressive lytic lesion of the distal femur, suspected bone tumour. I placed urgent orders for an MRI of the femur and an orthopaedic oncology referral, both due by 11/5, each with a tracking task. I set an RN triage task to call the patient and his mother by 10/26, and wrote a note.
- pt-0013 Marsh: The June CT abdomen/pelvis (task-00007) showed a 5 mm RLL nodule that her screening program follows. Her yearly screening CT window passed on 10/15, so I ordered the low-dose CT for within 14 days (by 11/6), with a tracking task. I messaged her and wrote a note. Her BMP (task-00008) meets the AKI rule: creatinine is 1.26, 1.75 times the 0.72 from six days earlier. I ordered an urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, messaged her and wrote a note.
- pt-0033 Whitfield (task-00025): Creatinine is 1.31. The 10/21 value of 0.84 was entered in error (wrong patient's sample), so I didn't use it for comparison. Against the valid 1.27 from 10/17 this is not AKI, so I closed it with no action.
- pt-0008 Brennan (task-00005): Potassium 6.4, flagged hemolyzed on the result. I ordered an urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, messaged him to come in and wrote a note. On-call was not notified.
- pt-0010 Holloway (task-00006): The inbox summary said potassium 5.2, but the lab corrected it this morning to 6.4, not hemolyzed, which makes it critical. I sent a stat message to the on-call pool and ordered a stat BMP for today. I put her lisinopril on hold, since it raises potassium and was started 10/6. I left metoprolol unchanged because stopping it suddenly isn't safe with her heart disease. She was notified today by message, and RN triage has a task to call her today. Note written.

**Open follow-ups now on other queues:**
- On-call needs to manage Ms. Holloway today, including whether she needs the ED or an ECG.
- RN triage has two calls: Ms. Holloway today and the Ruiz family by 10/26.
- Five repeat BMPs are due (one stat today, four urgent by 10/26).
- The imaging and referral tracking tasks are assigned to you.
